notes.title: Game update
notes.content:
* Modify that the beetle ball that summons the beetle will not disappear when the use time is up.
    It will only be impossible to recruit beetles.
    Use the blank beetle ball to restore the timer and summon the beetle again.


* Reduce Blood Mantis' ability to 1/3. Reduce Giant Bee Queen's ability to 1/2.
* The reputation value of defeating the king monster is increased by 5 times.

* Added a new stacking limit for dyes.
* Added a new stacking limit for Beetle cards.
* Adjust the distribution location of monsters in advanced maps. 
   Add more regeneration points where beetles can be hung.

* The modified beetles will only attack other players' beetles of the same level. 
  And the chance is only 1/1000.

* Fixed the problem that the warehouse mall function can be opened outside the novice area.


* Modify the movement rules. When the height difference of the destination is too high, you will not be able to click directly to go there.You can use jumping skills to jump there, Or go to a place with a low altitude drop first and then climb up to a higher place. (Stair climbing concept).

   (This adjustment can greatly reduce the risk of moving in the wrong direction due to accidentally touching higher terrain railings.)

notes.title: [Minor update]
notes.content:
[Minor update content description]

*Added 4 new cricket regeneration points in the garden courtyard map.
  (The regeneration point is on the green land around the cafe below)

*Fix the bug that the development manual cannot be synthesized.

*Platinum coin item button on the open interface.
  (Skill reset, attribute reset, warehouse opening, etc.)

notes.title: [Update Notice] New doll system and correction update
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

This week's update is mainly to add the doll system to the game. And upload the doll CG.
(Players can use MOD to modify various cute anime dolls to replace)

So far, the expected MOD expansion props system of the Beetle Steam version has also been completed.
We look forward to using Steam's unique MOD system to allow players to obtain new collection fun and experience in the game at any time.

(In this regard, you can refer to the many games that support Mods on Steam,
See how other game players use MOD to upload various CG pictures, animation character shapes, and various songs to enrich the game content)


In addition, the game has also been adjusted and modified for recent player reports and bugs.

The following is a detailed update description


[Description of update contents]

* Added doll system and doll CG.

When you right-click on the doll prop, the CG picture of the little doll will appear.
At this point, you can use the arrow keys to move the doll CG to the desired position. The doll will be fixed at this position.
(It can be moved to the interface, and the doll will automatically retreat to the interface without blocking the interface)

*After calling out the doll CG, click the item again to close the doll CG*


*Modify that the bank warehouse can be opened when sitting down.


*Fixed the BUG that may cause abnormalities on the player side when opening the character card to change eggs.


*Modify that when you turn on the character card Gacha, you can definitely get a character card.


*Adjustment When the backpack or bank warehouse window is on the left side of the screen, the item name will be automatically adjusted to the right side of the window.


*Fixed the BUG of the return to rest button that only appears in the fighting arena when it appears on other maps.


*Fixed the bug that the fireball effect disappeared.



Thanks

Chao Ye

notes.title: [Update Notice] Added 130 character card CGs and content adjustments
notes.content:
[h1] [ 2023 / 06 / 23 ] Update Announcement[/h1]


[b]Today is the Dragon Boat Festival, first of all I wish you all a happy holiday. [/b]

This update mainly adds CG images of 130 character cards to the game.
This is also the largest update of Beetle Elf ever.


In addition, the game has also been adjusted and modified for the players' reports this week.
Mainly for beginners in terms of difficulty,


[Description of detailed adjustment content]

* Added 130 character card CG.

*When modifying the evolution beetle fails,

From the original 1/3 chance of returning enhancement +5, 1/5 chance of returning enhancement +0

Change to.

1/3 chance to return +7
1/5 chance to return +5
1/10 chance to return +1


*Fixed the bug that the blood bar of the monster was incorrectly displayed because the monster would naturally recover life.

*The blood recovery speed of all monsters is reduced by 1/5 to slow down the capture failure caused by the beetle's blood recovery speed too fast. Reduce the difficulty of attacking the king monster.

*Remove the restriction that the [Beetle Conquer] skill requires more than 1/2 of physical strength and magic power.

*Remove the restriction that beetles cannot be summoned immediately when switching maps.

*Added a special sound effect when the valuable card falls.

*Adjusted resource objects such as piles of stones and leaves, etc., will disappear immediately after collection.

*Shadows of all beetles are reduced by 1/2 for easy identification.



[i] We will add the CG of dolls in the revision next week (expected). It can completely add props to all MODs.[/i]


Thanks

Chao Ye

notes.title: Release Date Update - Final
notes.content:
[b]Only here, I apologize to players who have been following Beetle Elf over the years.[/b]

I am a game developer, producer - ChaoYe
www.grx.tw

Since Beetle Elf was released on Steam,
The ups and downs along the way have led to the continuous delay of the listing date.

Although the main reason is the lack of advertising resources as independent developers,


[But what really keeps the game from being delayed - is my heart for Beetle Elf]

I don't want to put Beetle Elf on the shelf without any advertising resources...


I'm very sorry...
I just, really hope to see the ad crowd and bring back those beautiful memories...


[hr][/hr]

Now, after I have personally completed the following two games,

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1490680/God_Sword/
https://store.steampowered.com/app/922870/Final_Hope/

I decided to add - Steam Support and Features item. to Beetle Elf.


[b] Looking forward to bringing new opportunities to Beetle Elf through the rich community resources of the Steam platform.[/b]

 
The following is the description of what I expect to add to the game in half a year:


[hr][/hr]


[h1][Beetle Elf's new listing changes][/h1]

[b]*Addition/extension of beetle trading cards[/b]

Turn all the beetle cards in the game into STEAM cards,
Let players have the opportunity to get various beetle cards as long as they go online and play in the game.
After collecting beetle cards, they can be auctioned and sold through the auction mechanism of STEAM cards.

And all of this can be done instantly in-game through STEAM's complete, secure card trading mechanism.



[b]*MOD support/enrichment[/b]

Added various MOD upload functions to the game,

As a game of elf worldview,
The player elf can pick up various items and props of human society in the game, and these props can be uploaded through MOD.

Let players enter the game every day, there are new MOD dolls, MOD comics, MOD music to collect,


[b]*More language implementation / vision[/b]

More extensions will be added to the language system in the game,
All displayed messages, including the player's name, more facial expressions, etc., will be translated in real time and presented in the language set by the player.

We hope that the world of Beetle Elf will no longer have nationality and language barriers.
In the game, every player can freely play the role he wants to play, and everyone he encounters may become friends.



[b]*Extension/enhancement of game content[/b]

Added triple the number of beetles and beetle cards,
The map adds day and night changes to generate locations in the same place but at different times, greatly enriching the number of maps.
Enhancement of the beetle competition system and more tiered competition.
Perfect riding system.
Added character CG appearance cards.
Added MOD to modify the interface, effects, headgear, clothes, weapon appearance system.


[hr][/hr]

Finally, we give ourselves and Beetle Elf a final release date. We will do our best.

However, we are still keeping an open mind.
Welcome any manufacturer's promotion and cooperation proposals.

We also welcome live broadcasters who assist in promotion, various MOD producers, and translation assistance in various languages.
As long as you have any ideas about Beetle Elf, you are welcome to write to discuss.

Thank you again for your interest in Beetle Elf along the way,

thanks

ChaoYe
